final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each owner a feedback message.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com), then messaged her. I said her site is clean and her contact email is easy to find. I suggested adding more about her background, projects and interests, plus some visual design and navigation.
- **Eve:** I messaged her that her blog is simple and her love of hiking comes through right away. I suggested adding trail stories, photos, route tips and gear recommendations, and organizing the posts with categories.
